purpose: Authoritative cross-session integration contract for conxius-platform

integrations.role: primary relational application database and Better Auth backing store
integrations.migrationPolicy: explicit migration artifact and owner approval required

integrations.role: explicitly assigned auth, data, storage, or realtime workloads with RLS
integrations.migrationPolicy: schema MCP and RLS verification required before changes

integrations.role: ephemeral cache, rate limiting, queues, or sessions only
integrations.migrationPolicy: never use as primary business database

integrations.role: AWS-owned relational workload only when explicitly assigned
integrations.migrationPolicy: AWS integration and owner approval required

integrations.role: server-only live API and telemetry upstream

continuityRules: Re-check connected integrations before every integration-dependent change.
Never commit, print, or expose secret values; only report configured/missing status.
Do not infer schema or perform migrations when schema access is unavailable.
Every user-data query must be scoped to the authenticated user where applicable.
Production UI must show live provenance or unavailable state, never fabricated fallback data.
